I don't think player owned/created corporations and stations is the solution. It will affect the ambience of the Universe and immersion, especially with the proliferation of the ---P3Ni$COck$ Y0rMon-- Corps.

Some thoughts: Players choose one of the many corporations that are scattered about (Frontier keeps control of Lore in the Universe). At one of their stations, you find a mission to do something for them to join that corp. You work on the missions the station needs (or do trades, security works etc.) and gain reputation. Eventually a promotion mission arrives to become a prospect. Then a mission to associate, then to member and so on (with exponential increase of mission investment for each rank jump).

Each Corp type depending on their empire allegiance and intentions, has a default organizational structure that you can advance through via missions when possible and available. The human part of the corps organizational structure would have levels built in. For example, in terms of rank, there would only be 1 CEO position, 5 VP's, 15 Veterans, 200 members, unlimited for prospects and associates. If a you die without insurance or your reputation with another corp becomes higher, you will lose your rank with your current corp, and the VP with the most reputation becomes the new CEO (all members move up accordingly). And you, would now be a member in the other corp. There would also be support requirements to maintain rank.

For collaboration, once you go from associate to member (or whatever member rank the structure), you get access to the members list. Here you see the human commanders who are members and their rank in the group. There must also be a text chat tab just for that corporation which all members can see if selected. The game can include a few NPC type ranks in the corp if necessary to maintain lore. Then let the game do its thing with it procedural mission generation which if fulfilled can gradually influence the corporations power and controlled territory. This will generate mission and cause conflict with neighbouring corporation who might too be controlled by humans commanders, who may just be trying to expand as well.

As a side note, it would be cool if your account in game handle was just a nick name, but you could RNG a universe name which is based on randomized presets that fit in with the lore of the universe (we've all seen those star wars name generators). That name is then used for Galnet News Articles and stories of that Corp.

The candidates in the running for the Primaries is, at least to me really really weird this cycle. Or is this quite normal? The Republicans have something like 30 candidates none of which are a clear frontrunner, or particularly strong. While the democrats have less than a dozen with a couple options that have any shot at winning. I also cant help but notice that this is after several major strikes against traditional Republlican held beliefs. ELi5, what's up?
Is there any particular reason for the current Primary Situation on America?

Primaries tend to follow cycles based on both the likely general trend and the presence of other strong candidates in the party. This year the Republicans mostly view the general as favorable relative to further into the future and there isn't a stand out candidate leading the pack so everyone with presidential ambitions is trying. While the Democratic party saw Hillary as pretty inevitable and expect years further out to be more favorable so strong candidates mostly prefer to bide their time, with the exception of those who are running to shift the direction of the party so they can achieve goals in a loss.

CUSTOM MATCH IMPROVEMENTS

We’ve been holding back the release of Tactical Insertions – a Field Support item – due to the feedback from the community. Many players were worried that Tactical Insertions would greatly affect public matches, especially when used by fireteams who have better coordination and teamwork. Previously, we did not have the ability to release Tactical Insertions while preventing their usage in Public Matches. Now Custom Matches allow us to release them without impacting Public Matches – giving our players the option to choose to use them if and when they want to. Tactical Insertions and ATHENA Grenades will spawn in the players’ inventory for that match if the modifier is enabled – there will be no need to purchase these items from the store. *Players will have to manually equip them at the start of each match, and they will de-spawn from the players’ inventory after the match.

Renamed "Loadout Restrictions" to "Loadout Settings"

Two additional match modifiers have been added to “Loadout Settings”: “Enable ATHENA Grenades” and “Enable ATHENA Tactical Insertion”

When ATHENA Grenades are enabled, four types of ‘unlimited’ (x999) ATHENA grenades will be available for use in the match. The existing limit of 1 grenade per life will still be enforced.When ATHENA Tactical Insertion is enabled, an ‘unlimited’ (x999) set of ATHENA Tactical Insertions will be available for use in the match

When enabled, they will spawn in players’ inventory. Players will need to manually equip these items and they only exist for that match.

MAPS

The Rig TDM map has been added to the Team Deathmatch, Custom Match and Clan Match playlist

Various advertisements can now be found in some maps

MAXIMUM LEVEL CAP INCREASED

We’re increasing the level cap in-game so that we can reward our veteran players for playing. Players will receive a total of 30 Gold Keys and 32 Platinum Keys, and Infinite Pack Owners will receive another 30 unlocked Platinum Boxes and 12 unlocked Diamond Boxes additionally as they level up.

The maximum level cap have been increased from 50 to 70

Note for Infinite Pack owners, the Golden Desert Eagles and All Classes Level 50 Avatar will still unlock when all three classes are at level 50.

NEW, NEW USER EXPERIENCE

We are introducing a new user experience for new players who create their accounts after Update 2.0, known as “Starter Players”. For all existing players, rejoice as we will be removing armor maintenance and granting all players with 600 storage slots.

Removed the armor maintenance feature

Granted all players 600 free inventory slots (note that storage limit still remains at 1000)

Massively increased generosity with new players:

New players will receive Infinite Pack rewards from level 1-15 for all three classes for free

New players will also receive additional consumables and weapon attachments to provide a comprehensive gameplay experience Note that this change is not retroactive: players who are already above level 15 will not receive these rewards, players who created their accounts before 2.0 who are below level 15 will receive these reward

Implemented Class Lock and Unlock system for Starter Players

Recon available from level 1

Assault available from level 6

Support available once Recon or Assault reaches level 11

Implemented a Game Mode Lock and Unlock system for Starter Players

Team Deathmatch playlist available from level 1

Team Capture playlist available from level 10

Clan Matches and Custom Matches are available from level 1

Disabled several features for Starter Players:

Level 15 cap

Locked the in-game store, Ghost Coin purchases and ATHENA Armory Access subscription

Blocked selling items and scrapyard

Disabled irrelevant Targeted Offers

Unable to view their personal profile and leaderboards

Unable to gift or receive gifts, except for the Infinite Pack

All abovementioned restrictions for Starter Players will be unlocked after upgrading to the Infinite Pack

Starter Players will still be able to earn and accumulate ATHENA Credits and Ghost Coins and experience points which will be unlocked after upgrading to the Infinite Pack.

Implemented a new homepage design to streamline new user experience and guide players to the most important aspects of the game.
